init_model_he_fout: init a PyTorch network's Conv2d weights using He fan-out initialization strategy
init_model_he_fin: init a PyTorch network's Conv2d weights using He fan-in initialization strategy
set_bn_param: set the momentum and epsilon parameters on all BatchNorm2d layers in a network
get_bn_param: get the current momentum and epsilon parameters from the first BatchNorm layer in a network
load_weights_from_pretrained: load pretrained weights from a checkpoint file into a PyTorch network's state dict
